definitions.full: H6916. qiddah קִדָּה noun feminine a spice , usually cassia ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ᵑ6 compare Di Ex ; √ dubious; perhaps foreign word); *— merchandise Ezek 27:19 ; ingredient of sacred oil Exod 30:24 (P): — compare Dioscor: De Mater. Med. I.12 ( κασσία = ἡ κιττώ ) Theophr Hist. Paint ix. 5 Plin NH xii. 19 (42 ff.) ; see also Schröd Phoenician Spr. 126 Lewy Fremdw. 36 . [ קָדַח ] verb be kindled, kindle (Late Hebrew id. , also bore , Aramaic קְדַח , bore, kindle ; Arabic strike fire (with flint, etc.); Phoenician מקדח is lamp-lighter (in temple) accusative To CIS I, No.352, i.s ); — Qal 1. be kindled: Perfect 3feminine singular בְּאַמִּי קָֽדְחָה אֵשׁ Deut 32:22 ; Jer 15:14 , 14 ; 17:4 (reading קָֽדְחָה for קְדַחְתֶּם ), all of ׳י s wrath. 2 active kindle; Infinitive construct הֲמָסִים אֵשׁ כִּקְדֹחַ Isa 64:1 (see [ הֶמֶס ]); Participle אֵשׁ קֹדְחֵי 50:11 .
